Page No.# 2/2 This application has been filed under section 482 of BNSS praying for granting pre-arrest bail to the accused petitioner in connection with Jirighat P.S Case No. 23/2025 u/s 303(2)/317(2)/318(1) of BNS, 2023 r/w section 59 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006.

The petitioners apprehend the arrest in connection with the aforesaid case since they have been given an impression that they have been named by the main accused/driver of the vehicle which was suspected to be carrying stolen betel nuts of Burmese origin.

The learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the driver who was driving the vehicle has already been directed to be released on bail by the order dated 10.12.2025 passed by the Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class Lakhipur, Cachar and therefore, he prays that the petitioners may be allowed the privilege of pre-arrest bail and they would co-operate with the investigation.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class Lakhipur, Cachar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: We have gone through the order passed by the learned JMFC where there is a reference the CD till that time did not contain any effective entries.

In the meantime, it is directed that in the interim till the next listing date,
in the event of his arrest, in connection with the case, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 15,000/- with two surety to the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the following conditions;
i) That the accused person shall co-operate with the investigation and appear before the I/O for further examination as and when required.
ii) That the accused person shall not hamper or tamper with the evidence.
In case of violation of any bail conditions, the bail will be liable to be cancelled.
